packageRules.description: CLIs that must match a running server: bump only after Omni, Talos or Kubernetes is upgraded.
prBodyNotes: Merge only after the Omni server, Talos and Kubernetes in talos-argocd-proxmox run these versions.

packageRules.description: Review major upgrades separately from routine updates and each other.
Strata is a fast-moving fork: bump the upstream commit only on approval, never automerge.
prBodyNotes: Also bump images/strata/VERSION in this PR to `<upstream CMakeLists version, padded to four numbers (0.1.57 -> 0.1.57.0)>-<first 7 of the new commit>-sm86` (drop any fifth image-revision number); the pin check fails until it matches. After the image publishes, Renovate opens the digest bump in talos-argocd-proxmox.

packageRules.description: vLLM patches must re-apply and pass smoke before any base bump.
prBodyNotes: Bump images/vllm-qwen38-dualfast/VERSION and re-check all vendored patch anchors before merging.

packageRules.description: llama.cpp tags several builds a day: bump only on approval.
prBodyNotes: Also set images/llama-cpp/SOURCE_REF to the new tag's commit; the pin check fails until it matches.

packageRules.description: ARTEX runs database migrations on start: review each release, never automerge.
prBodyNotes: Also set images/artex/SOURCE_REF to the commit of tag v<VERSION> (`git ls-remote https://github.com/BaaRai/ARTEX.git 'refs/tags/v<VERSION>^{}'`); the pin check fails until it matches. After the image publishes, bump the talos deployment with the digest from the main run summary.

packageRules.description: ARTEX base tags must match upstream's Dockerfile: Renovate bumps their digests only.

prBodyNotes: Re-vendor all patch directories, update the Dockerfile revision label and bump VERSION; changing SOURCE_REF alone does not update patch code.

packageRules.description: sccache publishes a bare-hash .sha256 file, so Renovate cannot update the pinned tarball hash itself.
prBodyNotes: Copy the hash from the release's `sccache-v<version>-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz.sha256` asset into `SCCACHE_SHA256` in images/arc-runner-rust/Dockerfile. The build fails until it matches.

Track the pinned llama.cpp release tag.
Track the digests that pin the ARTEX Dockerfile's mutable base tags.
Track the vendored club-3090 patch source for manual review.
